title: Restart from the left boundary
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $r$ be a natural number, let $\mathrm{dec}$ be a function from natural numbers to Boolean values, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. For any amplified-machine configuration $C$, run index $j$ among $0,\ldots,r$, counter $c$ among $0,\ldots,r+1$, and choice bit $b$, if $C$ is in the seek phase for run $j$ with counter $c$ and its input head is at position $0$, then one step under $b$ gives the configuration obtained from $C$ by setting its state to the start of run $j$ with counter $c$ and its input-head position to $1$.
